`npm test` is green again: 517 of 517 pass. I haven't committed the fix.

Two commits since v2.0.0 each introduced a bug. Both were in source, so I didn't touch the tests.

- **`4188e9a` (Invoice: per-line discount groundwork)** set `taxable = subtotal` in `src/invoice.js`, so tax was computed before the order-level code (e.g. SPRING10) came off. I changed it to `subtotal - discount`. This fixed the two `buildInvoice SPRING10 in CA-ON` failures and the CA-ON total row in `renderInvoice`.
- **`958d3ae` (Money: thousands separators)** changed `String(abs % 100).padStart(2, "0")` to `padEnd` in `src/money.js`. That made 1 cent print as `$0.10` instead of `$0.01`. I changed it back to `padStart`. This fixed the four `formatMoney` failures and the `PIN-03` render row.

The line discounts, empty-invoice check, JSDoc, thousands separators, new currencies and new US states are all still there.
